final_answer.description: Exact selected final answer only, with no extra commentary.

branch_id.description: Short branch id such as A, B, or C.

strategy.description: Concise name or sentence describing this branch's solving strategy.

rule_hypothesis.description: Compact statement of the rule inferred by this branch.

evidence.description: One to three short sentences citing why the branch supports its candidate answer.

candidate_answer.description: This branch's exact candidate answer, formatted like the benchmark answer.

selected_answer.description: Consensus-selected final answer. Must equal final_answer.

agreement.description: How the branches agreed or how the answer was selected.

selected_branch_ids.description: Ids of branches that support the selected answer.

resolution.description: Brief explanation of why the consensus answer was selected.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in final_answer after branch aggregation.
